scope: FROM television through S4E10 If a Tree Falls in the Forest..., aired 28 June 2026. Spoilers for seasons one through four. No leaks, season-five predictions presented as fact, clinical diagnoses or extended graphic descriptions. Important late updates are explicit; do not write as if only season three has aired.

sources.fact: Victor's childhood survival, drawings, cached possessions and his relationship with Ethan form a persistent record, but the series shows gaps and corrections.
Victor initially attributes Christopher's conversation to Jasper; S3E8 corrects this to the Boy in White. Sara helps him recall it.
Victor remembers Eloise and Miranda; the reunion with Henry introduces an independent person from his former home, without resolving every missing-family question.
The S3 finale reveals Tabitha and Jade's relation to Miranda and Christopher and the earlier attempts to save the children; Victor's personal history intersects that longer pattern.
S4 Victor recalls the Man in Yellow as a former apparent resident and the later treatment of Miranda's body; at the car he fears Ethan may repeat his childhood isolation.
Henry's visions offer a life with another Victor and demand he remove the real Victor. The actors discuss the manipulation and strain; these visions are not verified escape instructions.
The Boy in White warns against uprooting the bottle tree; Boyd restrains Victor, the plan goes ahead, and the finale's protections fail amid a new crisis.
Henry attempts to shoot Victor; Ethan interrupts and Victor disarms his father. Both survive this scene. The actors describe a reversal toward Victor caring for Henry.

In S4E7 Boyd tells Henry and Victor about Tabitha/Miranda. Henry reacts with distress; Victor asks Tabitha about being his mother and seeks her help in investigating the Man in Yellow. Current family relationships remain distinct. Boyd tells Henry and Victor about Miranda and Tabitha. In S4E7 Victor asks Tabitha in the graveyard whether she is his mother, seeks her help, and takes her and Ethan to the Man in Yellow's car. Tabitha and Ethan tell Julie. Henry struggles with the revelation and Sophia's manipulation.
sources.work: S4E7 Best Laid Plans, supported by cast interview and episode recap

sources.fact: S1E3 Victor measures by steps from house corner to nearby trees. Initially dismisses Ethan, becomes interested when Ethan asks about boy in forest. Says checking whether trees move. Julie comes out to scold Ethan for being outside. No established tree speed, cause, teleportation or compass survey.

S1E10 and S2E1 Boy in White sends Victor underground; he meets Tabitha after excavation, guides her among sleeping creatures, warns quiet. They exit to forest and cargo truck. Boyd, Tabitha, Victor, Elgin survive and return town S2E2. Victor has hidden supplies/drawings. No control over creatures/portals.

Victor gives Tabitha lunchbox for tower journey S2 end. Wakes outside in Camden, finds address on lunchbox and visits Henry. Henry recognizes missing sons lunchbox but doubts her story; missing-family news helps discussion. Distinguish address from supernatural exit directions. Victor predicting result unconfirmed.
